notes: What has been building: subjects the writer noticed in a day's headlines and did not write a narrative about, kept from edition to edition with the headlines that showed them. Some things never lead a day; this is where they are held until the days add up.

A subject is open while it has been seen in the last fourteen days. When a narrative is written from it, it is marked written with that narrative; when it goes fourteen days unseen it lapses. Sightings are added, never reworded.
The subjects first entered on 15 November 2026 were drawn by hand from the stored collections of 1 to 14 November, to start the notebook; every later sighting is the writer's.
